description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single-target Lightning/Holy/NE physical attacks (0.9 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Double Crystarium Mode II (Lightning, Holy)], [Lightning/Holy Resonance 5% Boost], & Dual Awoken Sublime Thunder Mode I to the user
Dual Awoken Sublime Thunder Mode I: Lightning/Holy Ability Boost, Triplecast Lightning/Holy, Quick Lightning/Holy & chases 1/2/3 Lightning/Holy abilities with Lightning/Holy Ability Damage +10/20/30%

description.name: Awoken Requiem of the Goddess (Dual Shift)
description.text:
Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Smart Ether 3] & Dual Awoken Sublime Thunder Mode II to the user, removes Dual Awoken Sublime Thunder Mode I
Dual Awoken Sublime Thunder Mode II: When status is removed, grants [ATK +80%] & chases Lightning/Holy abilities with 10 single-target Lightning/Holy/NE physical attacks (0.28 each) for 8 seconds
